ApiKey.description: Represents an API key used for authenticating requests to the CockroachDB Cloud API.

id.description: Unique identifier of the API key.

name.description: Human-readable name of the API key.

service_account_id.description: Service account associated with this API key.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the API key was created.

PaginationResponse.description: Pagination metadata included in list responses.

next.description: Token or cursor for retrieving the next page of results.

last.description: Token or cursor for the last page of results.

time.description: Server time at which the paginated query was executed.
